name: grawlix
description: Browser-based wordlist manager for crossword constructors. See site/index.html.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build && GRAWLIX_SITE_DIR=dist scripts/with-test-lock.sh playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:dist
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && GRAWLIX_SITE_DIR=dist npm run test:browser
